title: Administrator Dashboard totals
steps: Open the Admin Dashboard and compare the user cards with the user list.

title: User search and status filter
steps: Search for Account B and for an unknown name; filter by status.

title: Owner cannot open admin pages
steps: Sign in as a farm owner (Account B) and open four admin pages.

title: Signed-out access to admin pages
steps: Open three admin pages while signed out.

title: Disable and enable a user
steps: Disable Account B, try its open session and sign-in, then enable it.
expected: Disabled user cannot use the system; enabled user can; owners cannot use the control.

title: Feedback review and response
steps: Owner submits feedback; admin filters, reads and answers it; owner checks it.
expected: Admin can read and answer; the owner sees the response.
actual:
SCRIPT STOPPED (TimeoutError) line 84: Page.fill: Timeout 25000ms exceeded.
Call log:
  - waiting for locator("#email")

title: Delete feedback with confirmation
steps: Delete the test message: Cancel first, then Confirm.
expected: Cancel keeps it; Confirm removes only it.

title: Delete-user confirmation
steps: Click Delete for Account B, then Cancel.
expected: A confirmation prompt appears and Cancel keeps the account.

title: Admin cannot disable or delete own account
steps: Look at the signed-in administrator's own row.
expected: Its Disable and Delete buttons are turned off.
actual: Exactly one row, the signed-in administrator, has Disable and Delete turned off.

title: Password reset requests page
steps: Open the page without changing anything.
expected: Pending and resolved requests are shown.
actual: Page opened with pending and resolved sections. Viewed only; no request was changed.

title: Password reset needs the user's answers
steps: Open the reset page for Account B without submitting.
expected: The user's recovery answers are required.

title: Export users button
steps: Follow the Export button on the Admin Dashboard.
expected: A file of users is downloaded.
actual: Export opens /admin/accounts/userprofile/: HTTP 403, text/html; no file is produced.
